items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: He says you must come to Houston, you must come to Houston and bring the band.

ctx.x: Yeah, but he was in Houston then and happened to be in Denison and he happened to catch the group. He says you must come to Houston, you must come to Houston and bring the band. So we set up a date and got together and went to Houston and it was well worth it, but to show you--I'm trying to think what year it was--but he was only guaranteeing me a hundred and twenty five dollars a night, and I was going clear to Houston, but we had some percentage figured in there, but it finally

worked out to be real good, because he had me booked besides Milton Larkin and that was when Arnett Cobb and Jacquett was in the band, and of course he had heard about--I don't know if I had Bud Douglass yes--but anyway, before I had--I was standing tenor man--well everybody (inaudible) Luther West and Spurgeons and of course (inaudible). He said you sure have a fine sax man.
